sentences.en: I want the students to take note that Dr. Christensen
sentences.zh: 我希望学生们注意，克里斯滕森医生

sentences.en: is entering on the medial line just above the pubis.
sentences.zh: 正从耻骨正上方的中线切入。

sentences.en: As you can see, there is significant blood in the cavity.
sentences.zh: 如你所见，体腔内有大量血液。

sentences.en: Vacuum ever.
sentences.zh: 随时准备吸引器。

sentences.en: Surgeons from this time were doing pioneering work,
sentences.zh: 那个时代的医生在做开创性的工作，

sentences.en: and patients were pioneering guinea pigs.
sentences.zh: 而患者则是开创性的试验品。

sentences.en: It had to start somewhere.
sentences.zh: 总得有个开始。

sentences.en: But that show makes me so, so happy
sentences.zh: 但那部剧让我感到无比、无比庆幸

sentences.en: that I live in the 21st century.
sentences.zh: 自己生活在 21 世纪。

sentences.en: Agreed.
sentences.zh: 同感。

sentences.en: Things were bad.
sentences.zh: 那时候情况很糟。

sentences.en: And they stayed bad for cancer patients for quite a while.
sentences.zh: 而且癌症患者的恶劣处境持续了相当长一段时间。

sentences.en: As late as 1920,
sentences.zh: 直到 1920 年代后期，

sentences.en: only 15% or so of patients
sentences.zh: 只有大约 15% 的患者

sentences.en: survived a cancer diagnosis
sentences.zh: 在确诊癌症后

sentences.en: for more than two years.
sentences.zh: 能存活两年以上。

sentences.en: Almost everyone died.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有人都死了。

sentences.en: So the numbers were bleak.
sentences.zh: 所以数据令人沮丧。

sentences.en: And in 1900, the numbers were even worse.
sentences.zh: 而在 1900 年，数据甚至更糟。

sentences.en: Which must be why they felt they needed a crematorium on site.
sentences.zh: 这一定就是为什么他们觉得有必要在现场建一个火葬场。

sentences.en: Which must have been a really spooky sight if you were there
sentences.zh: 如果你当时身处那里，

sentences.en: and you could look out your window
sentences.zh: 往窗外望去

sentences.en: and see the smokestack.
sentences.zh: 能看到那个大烟囱，那一定是个非常诡异的景象。

sentences.en: I mean, imagine looking out there and seeing smoke
sentences.zh: 我是说，想象一下向外望去，看到烟雾

sentences.en: come out of that smokestack.
sentences.zh: 从那个烟囱里冒出来。

sentences.en: That would have been pretty awful.
sentences.zh: 那一定相当可怕。

sentences.en: Under that billowing smoke,
sentences.zh: 在那滚滚浓烟之下，

sentences.en: the New York Cancer Hospital soon earned a nickname.
sentences.zh: 纽约癌症医院很快赢得了一个绰号。

sentences.en: The Bastille.
sentences.zh: 巴士底狱。

sentences.en: It was trying to look like a French chateau,
sentences.zh: 它试图模仿法国城堡的外观，

sentences.en: but it ended up feeling like a French prison.
sentences.zh: 但最终给人的感觉却像是一座法国监狱。

sentences.en: Which is why, despite a huge demand for cancer treatment,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么尽管对癌症治疗的需求巨大，

sentences.en: the hospital couldn't get people in the door.
sentences.zh: 这家医院却招揽不到病人。

sentences.en: The fact is that very few people wanted to go
sentences.zh: 事实是，极少有人愿意去

sentences.en: to the New York Cancer Hospital.
sentences.zh: 纽约癌症医院。

sentences.en: And what's amazing is that
sentences.zh: 而令人惊奇的是，

sentences.en: the place struggled financially.
sentences.zh: 这个地方在财务上举步维艰。

sentences.en: Cancer care before 1900
sentences.zh: 1900 年之前

sentences.en: and for a long time after was not lucrative.
sentences.zh: 以及之后很长一段时间，癌症护理并不赚钱。

sentences.en: The hospital also tried to attract patients and funds
sentences.zh: 该医院还试图通过采购一种备受争议的新型药物

sentences.en: by procuring a controversial new form of medicine.
sentences.zh: 来吸引患者和资金。

sentences.en: Radium.
sentences.zh: 镭。

sentences.en: For a while, around 1920,
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，大约在 1920 年左右，

sentences.en: the New York Cancer Hospital boasted
sentences.zh: 纽约癌症医院拥有

sentences.en: the country's single largest repository of radium.
sentences.zh: 全美最大的单一镭储藏库。

sentences.en: Marie Curie visited to check out the radium repository in 1921
sentences.zh: 玛丽·居里于 1921 年参观了镭储藏库，

sentences.en: in a trip that made headlines.
sentences.zh: 这次行程登上了各大媒体头条。

sentences.en: But radiation therapy, even more so than surgery,
sentences.zh: 但放射疗法，甚至比手术更甚，

sentences.en: was not understood.
sentences.zh: 是人们所不了解的。

sentences.en: It was administered by people who didn't know
sentences.zh: 它是由那些根本不知道

sentences.en: how to administer it
sentences.zh: 该如何实施的人管理的，

sentences.en: because they didn't really understand it.
sentences.zh: 因为他们并不真正了解它。

sentences.en: And a lot of the radiation workers, doctors, and nurses
sentences.zh: 许多辐射工作者、医生和护士

sentences.en: themselves developed cancer.
sentences.zh: 自己也得了癌症。

sentences.en: It wasn't until the 1930s or so
sentences.zh: 直到 20 世纪 30 年代左右，

sentences.en: that things started to improve.
sentences.zh: 情况才开始有所改善。

sentences.en: Surgery became better.
sentences.zh: 手术变得更好了。

sentences.en: The radiation treatments were working.
sentences.zh: 放射治疗起作用了。

sentences.en: I think in the 1960s and 1970s,
sentences.zh: 我想在 20 世纪 60 年代和 70 年代，

sentences.en: then you have, you know, chemotherapy
sentences.zh: 然后你就会看到，化学疗法

sentences.en: and just a much more organized approach to cancer care
sentences.zh: 以及更有条理的癌症护理方法的出现，

sentences.en: and one that ultimately became very lucrative.
sentences.zh: 这种方法最终变得非常赚钱。

sentences.en: In 1939, the cancer hospital left 455 Central Park West
sentences.zh: 1939 年，这家癌症医院从中央公园西路 455 号

sentences.en: for the Upper East Side,
sentences.zh: 搬到了上东区，

sentences.en: where it became Memorial Sloan Kettering,
sentences.zh: 并在那里成为了纪念斯隆凯特琳癌症中心，

sentences.en: which is now known as one of the best hospitals
sentences.zh: 它现在被称为美国最好的

sentences.en: for cancer treatment in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 癌症治疗医院之一。

sentences.en: And of course, hospitals don't look like castles anymore.
sentences.zh: 当然，医院看起来不再像城堡了。

sentences.en: After World War I, hospitals start to look like...
sentences.zh: 第一次世界大战后，医院开始看起来像……

sentences.en: Small civic institutions, more like city halls or schools.
sentences.zh: 小型公民机构，更像是市政厅或学校。

sentences.en: They're very square.
sentences.zh: 它们非常方正。

sentences.en: It's called the block plan.
sentences.zh: 这被称为街区规划。

sentences.en: We also see the end of big open wards with lots of beds.
sentences.zh: 我们还看到了拥有许多床位的大型开放式病房的终结。

sentences.en: Paying patients could expect single rooms
sentences.zh: 付费患者可以期望住单人间，

sentences.en: or typical patients could be in a double room
sentences.zh: 普通患者可以住双人间

sentences.en: or a room of four patients.
sentences.zh: 或是四人间。

sentences.en: And we said goodbye to good food, champagne, and carriage rides.
sentences.zh: 我们向美食、香槟和马车出行道别了。

sentences.en: The money was channeled in things like surgical suites
sentences.zh: 资金被引导投入到手术室

sentences.en: and in mechanical equipment rather than in decoration.
sentences.zh: 和机械设备中，而不是装饰上。

sentences.en: And we see things like wooden beds and dressers disappear.
sentences.zh: 我们看到木制床铺和梳妆台之类的东西消失了。

sentences.en: Everything becomes metal and has a kind of look of efficiency.
sentences.zh: 一切都变成金属材质，并带有一种高效的外观。

sentences.en: After World War II, the office building slash skyscraper
sentences.zh: 第二次世界大战后，办公楼兼摩天大楼

sentences.en: becomes the model for hospitals.
sentences.zh: 成为了医院的模范。

sentences.en: It all changes again in the 1980s
sentences.zh: 这一切在 20 世纪 80 年代再次改变，

sentences.en: with the onset of what we call patient-centered care,
sentences.zh: 随着我们所称的以患者为中心的护理的兴起，

sentences.en: where the atrium hospital just takes off.
sentences.zh: 中庭式医院蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: These are hospitals that look like shopping malls.
sentences.zh: 这些是看起来像购物中心的医院。

sentences.en: Just one or two floors, big open spaces.
sentences.zh: 只有一两层楼，宽敞的开放空间。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a very kind of capsule history
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一种非常微缩的

sentences.en: of the 20th century hospital.
sentences.zh: 20 世纪医院发展史。

sentences.en: We've done away with completely round rooms now,
sentences.zh: 我们现在已经摒弃了完全圆形的房间，

sentences.en: but the general idea of round rooms being easier to keep clean
sentences.zh: 但圆形房间更容易保持清洁的

sentences.en: has actually persisted.
sentences.zh: 总体理念实际上保留了下来。

sentences.en: So where the wall meets the floor,
sentences.zh: 所以当墙壁与地面相交时，

sentences.en: if you go visit a hospital today,
sentences.zh: 如果你今天去参观一家医院，

sentences.en: you'll see it's probably curved
sentences.zh: 你会发现它很可能是呈弧形的，

sentences.en: so that nothing could get stuck
sentences.zh: 这样就不会有任何东西卡在

sentences.en: in the right angle between the wall and the floor.
sentences.zh: 墙壁和地面之间的直角里。

sentences.en: As for the castle-like building
sentences.zh: 至于那座城堡般的建筑——

sentences.en: that housed the first cancer hospital,
sentences.zh: 曾容纳第一家癌症医院的建筑，

sentences.en: it went through another really dark period.
sentences.zh: 它经历另一个非常黑暗的时期。

sentences.en: In the mid-1950s, it becomes Tower Nursing Home.
sentences.zh: 在 20 世纪 50 年代中期，它变成了塔楼疗养院。

sentences.en: That becomes one of the most notorious nursing homes in New York
sentences.zh: 那成了纽约最声名狼藉的疗养院之一，

sentences.en: and is a place where terrible things happen,
sentences.zh: 是一个发生可怕事情的地方，

sentences.en: roaches crawling around walls
sentences.zh: 蟑螂在墙上爬来爬去，

sentences.en: and patients being abused.
sentences.zh: 患者受到虐待。

sentences.en: The nursing home was shut down in the 1970s
sentences.zh: 这家疗养院在 20 世纪 70 年代被关闭，

sentences.en: and the building sat vacant
sentences.zh: 大楼闲置了

sentences.en: and in a state of disrepair for a long time.
sentences.zh: 并且长时间处于失修状态。

sentences.en: Jim Rassenberger used to walk by it in the 80s
sentences.zh: 吉姆·拉森伯格在 80 年代经常从它旁边走过，

sentences.en: and said it was a spooky place.
sentences.zh: 并说这是一个诡异的地方。

sentences.en: It was like a haunted house, you know,
sentences.zh: 它就像鬼屋一样，你知道的，

sentences.en: but it was even better than that.
sentences.zh: 但它甚至比那更好。

sentences.en: It was a haunted castle.
sentences.zh: 它是一座鬼城堡。

sentences.en: It just seemed to be on an inevitable fall
sentences.zh: 它似乎注定要不可避免地

sentences.en: into a pile of bricks.
sentences.zh: 坍塌成一堆砖头。

sentences.en: There was really,
sentences.zh: 真的，

sentences.en: there didn't seem to be any escape from that fate
sentences.zh: 似乎没有什么方法能逃脱这种命运，

sentences.en: because it had gotten so bad,
sentences.zh: 因为它已经变得如此糟糕，

sentences.en: you thought, well, who's going to come in here now?
sentences.zh: 你心想，好吧，现在谁还会来这里？

sentences.en: I mean, who would come in
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，谁会来

sentences.en: and try to make something of this building?
sentences.zh: 并试图让这座建筑发挥点作用？

sentences.en: That was New York in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 那是 20 世纪 80 年代的纽约。

sentences.en: In 21st century Manhattan,
sentences.zh: 在 21 世纪的曼哈顿，

sentences.en: even haunted castles can be turned into luxury condominiuMs.
sentences.zh: 即使是鬼城堡也能变成豪华公寓。

sentences.en: In the year 2000,
the building was bought by a developer.
sentences.zh: 这栋建筑被一家开发商买下。

sentences.en: Now it's 17 condo units,
sentences.zh: 现在这里有 17 套公寓单元，

sentences.en: a parking garage,
sentences.zh: 一个停车场，

sentences.en: a spa,
sentences.zh: 一个水疗中心，

sentences.en: a pool,
sentences.zh: 一个游泳池，

sentences.en: and a fitness center.
sentences.zh: 和一个健身中心。

sentences.en: The hospital castle on the park
sentences.zh: 公园里的这座医院城堡

sentences.en: finally became on the inside
sentences.zh: 终于在内部实现了

sentences.en: what it always pretended to be on the outside.
sentences.zh: 它在外观上一直标榜的样子。

sentences.en: A nice place for rich people.
sentences.zh: 一个适合富人的好地方。
